text: I've been in this game for years, it made me an animal, it's rules to this shit, I wrote me a manual, a step by step booklet for you to get your game on track, let your mind be pushed back. Rule number uno, never let no one know how much dough you hold cause you know that cheddar breed gels, see especially if that man fucked up, get your ass stuck up. Number two, never let him know your next move, don't you know bad boys move in silence and violence, take it from your highness, I don't squeeze mad clips of these cats, I'm just a little bit of a bitch for these bricks and chips. Number three, never trust nobody, your mum will set us ass up, properly gassed up, hoodie to Moscow, shit for that fastback, she'll be laying on bushes to buy that asshole. Number four, you know you heard this before, never get high on your own supply. Number five, never sell no crack where you rest at, I don't care if they will run you stone or bones. Number six, that goddamn credit, daddy, do you think a crackhead would pay you back, shit forget it. Seven, this rule is so underrated, keep your family and business completely separated, money and blood don't mix like two dicks, no bitch, find yourself in serious shit. Number eight, never keep no weight on you, them cats that squeeze your guns can hold jobs too. Number nine should be number one to me, if you ain't getting bagged, take fuck from the police, if they think you snitching, they ain't trying to listen, they'll be sitting in your kitchen waiting to start hitting you. Number ten, this drill word called consignment, strictly for life, man, not for freshmen, if you ain't got the clientele, say hello, cause they're gonna want their money, rain, sleet, hail, snow. Fuck. Fuck. Fuck.
